title: The Crossing Guard
summary: A crossing guard leads the infected away from a school with nothing but a whistle.
inspired_by: https://youtu.be/z29UmjLHsFI (premise only: a clever safe haven built for a zombie world)

beats.text: The infected follow sound. I am a crossing guard with a loud whistle.
Thirty children hid in the gym. The street was full of them.
I stood in the road, blew the whistle, and ran. They followed me.
I led them around the block, lost them, and ran back to do it again.
By midnight my lungs burned, and the whistle cracked.
I dropped it in a gutter. The crowd turned back toward the school.
Then a whistle blew inside the school. Thin and cracked. Not mine.
A small boy stood at the doors with my spare whistle. He grinned and ran.
He led the whole crowd over the field in a long wobbling line.
At dawn he came back, soaked and proud, and asked to be a guard too.
